title: Salutations to the Goddess
translation: Salutations to the Goddess, the Great Goddess, to the auspicious one, always. Salutations to Prakriti, to the gracious one. With minds controlled, we bow to her.
translation_hi: देवी को, महादेवी को, कल्याणमयी शिवा को सदा नमस्कार है। प्रकृति को, भद्रा को नमस्कार है। हम संयमित होकर उन्हें प्रणाम करते हैं।

words.note: With the dative: नमः X-ai = 'salutation to X'.
Dative of devi. Feminine -i nouns take -यै.
sma makes the present past or emphatic.

grammar: Namah + dative: salutation always takes the dative ('to'): देव्यै, शिवायै, प्रकृत्यै. Compare शिवाय नमः.
Feminine dative -ai: devi → देव्यै, shiva → शिवायै, prakriti → प्रकृत्यै.
Setting: in chapter 5 of the Durga Saptashati, the gods, defeated by the demons Shumbha and Nishumbha, go to the Himalaya and praise the Goddess with this hymn.
